item.tib: sangs rgyas don yod zhags pa'i sgrub pa lasaH tshe sgrub bdud rtsi bum pa las kyi cha lags tshe 'gug lcags kyu gar gyi le'u
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas khro chu'i brag nas drangs te slar rgyal rong sa skyongs dbang gi pho brang bsam 'grub seng ge'i rdzong nas shog ser zhal bshus so/ tshe yi 'phrin las mtha' ru phyin par gyur cig//
